name: Hurricane Isaias
headline: Low over the southern Gulf ~7 Oct, MJO phases 1–2 favourable.

sections.The setup: El Niño shear suppresses the Atlantic (17% of normal energy); the Gulf is the exception.
sections.The trigger: Low over the southern Gulf ~7 Oct, MJO phases 1–2 favourable.
sections.What amplified it: Gulf water 28–29.5 °C; shear ~20 kt. Capped by rising shear (27–39 kt) and dry air before landfall as Cat 2.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
